ProfessionalEditView

class ProfessionalEditView(parent=None, professional=None)[source]

Bases: QDialog, Ui_ProfessionalEditView, WindowConfig

Modal dialog for creating or editing a professional.

The widgets come from Ui_ProfessionalEditView (Qt Designer); field filling, validation and data extraction are done by ProfessionalEditController.

Parameters:
parentQWidget | None, optional

Parent widget, usually the list window. Default is None.

professionalProfessional | None, optional

Professional to edit; None opens the dialog in creation mode. Default is None.

Attributes:
controllerProfessionalEditController

Controller of the dialog.

Notes

The title gets the suffix “ - Novo” or “ - Editar” (translated with self.tr()), and the window is 10% narrower and shorter than the parent (WindowConfig.setup_window).
